instructions_to_main_agent: Scaffold the monorepo with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Three.js/PixiJS for Aura effects.
Implement a Compositor (Window Manager) managing state: Launch, Focus, Suspend, Kill.
Windows must be translucent (0.8 opacity) with high-density blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) - 'Obsidian Glass' aesthetic.
Implement an 'Aura' effect behind active windows: a glowing drop-shadow or Canvas-rendered glow that pulses.
Build the Dock at the bottom. When cursor hits bottom-left corner, expand it into a full-screen dashboard.
Settings App must include Aura Effects controls: intensity slider, color shift mode, accent dots, transparency.
Include hot corner detection for the dashboard.
Follow 'Obsidian Glass' design exactly. Do not use generic solid colors for backgrounds.
Every window must have rounded corners (rounded-2xl) and a subtle 1px border (border-white/10).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
